The full draft report, reasons and decisions is available on the Commission’s website: https://comcom.govt.nz/regulated-industries/grocery/review-of-the-grocery-supply-code/_nocache

The full paper is available on the Commission’s website: https://comcom.govt.nz/regulated-industries/grocery/wholesale-supply-inquiry2/_nocache

Energy Innovations: Self-Driving Farm Vehicles

Explore how 45 South Orchards is harnessing self-driving vehicle technology to enhance efficiency during harvest and throughout the growing cycle. Find out more about EECA’s support for businesses at www.eeca.govt.nz/co-funding-and-support

Energy Innovations: Agricultural Spray Drone

Learn how Felton Road Wines is boosting efficiency by leveraging drone technology to take over tasks traditionally performed by diesel tractors. Find out more about EECA’s support for businesses at www.eeca.govt.nz/co-funding-and-support

Energy Innovations: Solar Powered Farming

Learn how Kawaiwai Dairies and Forest Lodge Orchard have embraced solar technology on their farms—and are now reaping the rewards. Find out more about the support EECA offers farmers at www.eeca.govt.nz/solaronfarms

EECA Market Update - June 2025

Our June market update features updates from our Chief Executive, Dr Marcos Pelenur, and other EECA leads regarding some of last quarter’s key projects to support progress across the energy landscape.

Leave The Girls Behind: Jacqueline Bublitz in interview. PART TWO

The second part of our very special in-depth, exclusive interview with international bestselling author Jacqueline Bublitz.   Jacqueline Bublitz  shot to international fame and acclaim with her debut novel Before You Knew My Name, which won two Ngaio Marsh Awards in 2022. The book was also the recipient of the Australian Book Industry Awards for General Fiction Book of the Year in the same year and shortlisted for the prestigious Gold Dagger Awards. 
Leave the Girls Behind is her second novel, with a third in the pipelines. She describes herself as a lover of rain and red wine.
Leave the Girls Behind is a spine-chilling, gripping, smart, topical, and compulsive page-turner of a thriller. The author herself described Leave the Girls Behind as a companion to her international bestselling, multi-award-winning debut novel Before You Knew My Name. It explores the various ways the justice system and society fail women, using a serial killer plot to delve into the theme of female resilience in the face of male violence.
The book is a powerful exploration of deep and important issues while also being eminently readable.

Become a WorkSafe health and safety inspector

We're looking for people to join WorkSafe to become health and safety inspectors.

Our inspectors have a key role in influencing work health and safety in Aotearoa. Our mahi makes a difference, to prevent people from being harmed at work.

No two days are the same: inspectors are out and about visiting priority sector workplaces, responding to notifications of unsafe working conditions, and in the office writing up reports and talking things over with the team.

If you're passionate about health and safety, visit our website to find out more: https://www.worksafe.govt.nz/about-us/careers/join-our-health-and-safety-inspectors/
